title: Audio responses keep their audio
summary:
Audio responses retain their payloads, the homepage gets a cleaner footer, and image generation handles GPU and usage limits more carefully.

The chat completion response schema now accepts the audio object returned by `openai-audio`, preserving its transcript and base64-encoded audio data instead of dropping them.

The homepage footer gained a responsive black-and-white layout, clearer link columns, and an X link. The News section also has an anchor for direct links.

Flux workers now scale oversized requests toward a 768×768 pixel budget to reduce out-of-memory failures, though large requests may produce smaller images. Image-model usage tracking was also unified, so Nano Banana headers can report its token count rather than defaulting to one.
